## Last-checked: 2026-09-16

# clirec

Canonical repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/clirec

## Summary

`clirec` is a local-first Python package for recording mouse and keyboard
demonstrations and explicitly opted-in synchronous microphone commentary.
Human-readable `.clirec` files remain the commit markers; format v2 stores
media in relative SHA-256-verified sidecars and keeps v1 readable.

Source version `0.3.0`. Not released: the repository has no tags and the name
`clirec` is unclaimed on PyPI, so `pip install clirec` does not resolve --
install from the repository.

## Audience & Target Personas

- `[PERSONA-01]` Autonomous AI Agent Engineers & Computer-Use Developers: Deterministic GUI demonstration traces for training, evaluation, and headless replay without vision-token overhead.
- `[PERSONA-02]` CLI & Workflow Automation Builders (Sysadmins / DevOps): Turn interactive desktop operations into scriptable CLI commands with parameterized inputs.
- `[PERSONA-03]` QA, Test Automation & E2E Validation Engineers: Versionable, git-friendly test runs with optional UIA metadata probing and SHA-256 media integrity.
- `[PERSONA-04]` Privacy-Conscious Teams & Enterprise Compliance Officers: Masked input defaults, zero-cloud egress, unprivileged `RunAsInvoker`, and strict audio consent boundaries (§ 201 StGB).

## Comparative Matrix & Governance Invariants

- 10-dimension comparison against Video Recorders (OBS/Loom), Web E2E (Playwright/Cypress), Macro Recorders (AutoHotkey), and Enterprise RPA (UiPath).
- Core Governance Invariants:
  - `INV-LOCAL-01` (100% Offline & Local-First Zero-Egress)
  - `INV-PRIVACY-02` (Default Parameter Sanitization & Text Masking)
  - `INV-INSPECT-03` (Human-Readable Plaintext Spec)
  - `INV-REPLAY-04` (Agent & CLI Native Replay via Injected Executor)
  - `INV-AUDIO-05` (Strict Dual-Opt-In Audio Consent Boundary)
  - `INV-SIDECAR-06` (Format v2 Atomic Media Sidecars with SHA-256)
  - `INV-ADAPTER-07` (Decoupled STT Adapter Architecture)
  - `INV-UNPRIV-08` (Unprivileged User-Mode Operation — RunAsInvoker)
  - `INV-PORTABLE-09` (Zero Mandatory Runtime Dependencies)
  - `INV-SLA-10` (Transparent Open-Source Governance & 48h Security SLA)

- `docs/AUDIO_PRIVACY.md` - Consent, retention, purge, backend, and privacy boundary.
- `docs/EPISODE_EXPORT.md` - Learning episode and extractor review contract.

## Related Projects

- open-compute (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute) - supplies the
  executor that replays a recording; exposes it as `oc rec replay`.
- open-compute-mcp (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/open-compute-mcp) - exposes the
  replay as the MCP tool `rec_replay`.
- ellmos-voice-io (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-voice-io) - local STT/TTS
  primitives; candidate to wrap as a `--module` backend for `clirec transcribe`.
- ellmos (https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos) - ecosystem hub.

## Boundaries

`clirec` is not a hosted telemetry service, a video recorder, or a full GUI
automation platform. Replay stays backend-neutral and needs an executor
integration. Safe recordings parameterize keyboard text; UI metadata and
explicitly unmasked sessions still require review before sharing. Audio is off
by default, is never replayed automatically, and is never auto-ingested into a
memory store, policy, workflow, cloud, or repository. `--audio-consent` is the
operator's own consent and never a bystander's -- recording other people's
speech is restricted by law in many jurisdictions (in Germany, § 201 StGB).
CLIRec imports optional audio and STT adapters chosen by the caller; it ships
no speech-to-text engine and no default STT module.
